1.web: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,
1.asv: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon our beloved and fellow-worker,

2.web: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus, our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
2.asv: and to Apphia our sister, and to Archippus our fellow-soldier, and to the church in thy house:

3.web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
3.asv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

4.web: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,
4.asv: I thank my God always, making mention of thee in my prayers,

5.web: hearing of your love, and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all the saints;
5.asv: hearing of thy love, and of the faith which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all the saints;

6.web: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective, in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.
6.asv: that the fellowship of thy faith may become effectual, in the knowledge of every good thing which is in you, unto Christ.

7.web: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.
7.asv: For I had much joy and comfort in thy love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through thee, brother.

8.web: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
8.asv: Wherefore, though I have all boldness in Christ to enjoin thee that which is befitting,

9.web: yet for love’s sake I rather beg, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
9.asv: yet for love’s sake I rather beseech, being such a one as Paul the aged, and now a prisoner also of Christ Jesus:

10.web: I beg you for my child, whom I have become the father of in my chains, Onesimus,
10.asv: I beseech thee for my child, whom I have begotten in my bonds, Onesimus,

11.web: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.
11.asv: who once was unprofitable to thee, but now is profitable to thee and to me:

12.web: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,
12.asv: whom I have sent back to thee in his own person, that is, my very heart:

13.web: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.
13.asv: whom I would fain have kept with me, that in thy behalf he might minister unto me in the bonds of the gospel:

14.web: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
14.asv: but without thy mind I would do nothing; that thy goodness should not be as of necessity, but of free will.

15.web: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while, that you would have him forever,
15.asv: For perhaps he was therefore parted from thee for a season, that thou shouldest have him for ever;

16.web: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother, especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
16.asv: no longer as a servant, but more than a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much rather to thee, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

17.web: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
17.asv: If then thou countest me a partner, receive him as myself.

18.web: But if he has wronged you at all, or owes you anything, put that to my account.
18.asv: But if he hath wronged thee at all, or oweth thee aught, put that to mine account;

19.web: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).
19.asv: I Paul write it with mine own hand, I will repay it: that I say not unto thee that thou owest to me even thine own self besides.

20.web: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
20.asv: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my heart in Christ.

21.web: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.
21.asv: Having confidence in thine obedience I write unto thee, knowing that thou wilt do even beyond what I say.

22.web: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
22.asv: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I hope that through your prayers I shall be granted unto you.

23.web: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
23.asv: Epaphras, my fellow-prisoner in Christ Jesus, saluteth thee;

24.web: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
24.asv: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, Luke, my fellow-workers.

25.web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
25.asv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
